SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_minor)/100.0 FROM sales_lines WHERE booked_date >= '2024-03-01' AND booked_date < '2024-04-01' AND currency='GBP') - (SELECT SUM(amount_minor)/100.0 FROM expense_lines WHERE booked_date >= '2024-03-01' AND booked_date < '2024-04-01' AND currency='GBP')

SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_minor)/100.0 FROM sales_lines WHERE booked_date >= '2024-03-01' AND booked_date < '2024-04-01' AND currency='GBP') - (SELECT SUM(amount_minor)/100.0 FROM expense_lines WHERE booked_date >= '2024-03-01' AND booked_date < '2024-04-01' AND currency='GBP')

WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status='delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'eligible_orders',COUNT(*) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_delivery_days',AVG(julianday(delivered_at)-julianday(purchased_at)) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT 'late_share',AVG(CASE WHEN delivered_at>estimated_at THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_review_late',AVG(r.score) FROM eligible o JOIN reviews r USING(order_id) WHERE o.delivered_at>o.estimated_at UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_review_on_time',AVG(r.score) FROM eligible o JOIN reviews r USING(order_id) WHERE o.delivered_at<=o.estimated_at

WITH counts AS (SELECT customer_person_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_person_id) SELECT 'people',COUNT(*) FROM counts UNION ALL SELECT 'repeat_share',AVG(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM counts UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_per_person',AVG(n) FROM counts

WITH unique_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM shipments), stats AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN purchased_at LIKE '2024-05%' THEN julianday(delivered_at)-julianday(purchased_at) END) a, AVG(CASE WHEN purchased_at LIKE '2024-06%' THEN julianday(delivered_at)-julianday(purchased_at) END) c, SUM(purchased_at LIKE '2024-05%' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL) n0, SUM(purchased_at LIKE '2024-06%' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL) n1, SUM(purchased_at LIKE '2024-06%' AND delivered_at IS NULL) pending FROM unique_orders) SELECT 'avg_days_previous',a FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_days_current',c FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'relative_change',(c-a)/a FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'eligible_previous',n0 FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'eligible_current',n1 FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_current',pending FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'status',CASE WHEN ABS((c-a)/a)>0.25 THEN 'CHANGE_DETECTED' ELSE 'NO_CHANGE' END FROM stats
